 Apple’s New iPad Mini Gets OLED and Water Resistance
 On the heels of the Duo, here comes the Mini. It's arriving Nov. 6.
 Scott Stein 
 Editor at Large
 I started with CNET reviewing laptops in 2009.… Read full bio 
 Scott Stein
 Editor at Large
 Read full bio 
 October 26, 2026, 9:27 am ET
 1 min read 
 The new iPad Mini has OLED and water resistance at last. Apple 
 The new iPhone Duo , unfolded, almost feels like an iPad Mini. But if you want the real thing, Apple also has a new iPad Mini coming on Nov. 6. The upgrade, which starts at $699, adds a larger OLED screen and water resistance for the first time.
 The new iPad Mini has been expected for months, and it was announced two days ahead of an expected showcase of new Macs on Wednesday . It has a number of updates this time around, making it look, on paper, like a killer upgrade for anyone who’s been waiting for one. Unfortunately, it’s also more expensive than before.
 One of the two new iPad Mini colors, midnight. Apple 
 The $699 starting price comes with 128GB of storage, with 256 and 512GB options that are $799 and $999. Compared to the last iPad Mini , which came out two years ago, the new one has an A20 processor (upgraded from A17), but also has a larger display (8.5 inches compared to the older one’s 8.3) that’s also OLED for the first time. The front-facing camera’s also been shifted to the landscape edge, matching the other iPads and making it more centered for video chats if you’re standing it on a table in a case.
 More from CNET
 It’s thinner and lighter than before, but also is the first iPad that’s water-resistant (IP67), which means it could survive pool, ocean or tub dunks. There’s a through-screen speaker system on this model, too, which I’m curious to try. It’s called Acoustic Display.
 The Mini’s available to order on Oct. 28, and is going on sale Nov. 6. We’ll have more thoughts when I eventually get to review one, but for anyone who’s wanted a new Mini and didn’t want to spring for a Duo this iPad looks like good news.
